indicators.name: Simple moving average

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.warmup: First output index n-1 (default8); require n valid consecutive bars.
indicators.edge_cases: Constant input returns the constant; no partial-window output.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 9/close documented; strict missing-window policy is an app choice.

indicators.name: Exponential moving average

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.formula: alpha=2/(n+1); seed at t=n-1 with SMA_n; thereafter y[t]=alpha*x[t]+(1-alpha)*y[t-1].
indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default8). Seed is a published output.
indicators.edge_cases: On explicit missing source reset and seed again; do not use adjust=True normalized finite-history EWMA.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 9/close follow general MA help. Exact seed-bar indexing is proposed; no Pine numerical equivalence established.
verification_cases: n3 on[1,2,3,4] -> [null,null,2,3]; contrast first-price seeded EMA.

indicators.name: Weighted moving average

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.formula: Weights1..n on oldest..newest; weighted sum divided by n*(n+1)/2.
indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default8).
indicators.edge_cases: Length1 equals source.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Length9/close adopted from general MA defaults, not separately verified standalone WMA defaults.
verification_cases: n3 on[1,2,3] ->14/6; n1 identity.

indicators.name: Volume-weighted moving average

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default19), provided total volume>0.
indicators.edge_cases: Zero total volume gives null; zero-volume bars contribute zero; missing/meaningless volume disables calculation.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Length20 selected from Technical Ratings configuration, not asserted standalone default.

indicators.name: Double exponential moving average

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.warmup: First output 2*(n-1) (default16), because each EMA seeds from n valid inputs.
indicators.edge_cases: Can overshoot price; do not clamp to window range.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Length9 and cascaded SMA seeds are app choices; formula does not fix seeds.
verification_cases: n3: no published output until index4; hand-check cascaded SMA seeds.

indicators.name: Triple exponential moving average

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.warmup: First output 3*(n-1) (default24).
indicators.edge_cases: Can overshoot; preserve precision between cascades.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Length9 and cascaded SMA seeds are app choices.
verification_cases: n3: no published output until index6; distinguish triple smoothing from TEMA combination.

indicators.name: Hull moving average

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.warmup: First output n+r-2 (default10).
indicators.edge_cases: Clamp derived lengths to1, so n1 is identity.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Floor chosen for positive integer conversion; TradingView support does not define rounding. Length9 selected from ratings.
verification_cases: Odd n7 uses h3,r2; n1 identity; ramp exposes rounding variants.

indicators.name: Kaufman adaptive moving average

parameters.validation: Integers length>=1 and 1<=fast<=slow; finite source.

indicators.warmup: Need n changes (n+1 bars). At first t=n set previous y=x[n-1], then update. First output default10.
indicators.edge_cases: If volatility sum=0, choose ER=0. Preserve constant source; reset on explicit missing input.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Length10, close, first valid index and previous-price seed are app choices; LEAN demonstrates a previous-price variant but its readiness semantics are not adopted.
TradingView article does not establish seed or zero-volatility result.
verification_cases: Constant series remains constant using ER0; monotonic ER1; reversal lowers ER; first output at n.

indicators.name: Arnaud Legoux moving average

parameters.validation: length integer>=1; offset in[0,1]; finite sigma>0; floor_center boolean.

indicators.formula: For i=0..n-1 oldest..newest, m=offset*(n-1), optionally floor(m); s=n/sigma; w_i=exp(-(i-m)^2/(2*s^2)); ALMA=sum(w_i*x[t-n+1+i])/sum(w_i).
indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default8).
indicators.edge_cases: n1 is identity. Use normalized/stable Gaussian weights if sigma is extreme; reject nonfinite weight sum.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 9/.85/6 documented. floor_center=false is an explicit app variant; LEAN uses true. Neither proves TradingView numerical behavior.
Use a trailing causal weighted sum; do not infer a future-looking two-pass filter from informal help prose.
verification_cases: n3 offset.5 symmetric weights preserve symmetric midpoint; floor_center true/false differ at n9,.85; no future suffix affects prefix.

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands

parameters.validation: length integer>=1 and length>ddof; multiplier finite>=0; ddof in{0,1}; basis=sma initially.

indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default19).
indicators.edge_cases: Flat source gives coincident bands. Display rounding never feeds back.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 20/2/close documented; ddof0 is the explicit app population convention. Other basis choices require separate seed handling.
verification_cases: n3 x[1,2,3]: basis2,sigma=sqrt(2/3); sample convention gives1 instead.

indicators.name: Keltner Channels

parameters.validation: lengths integer>=1; multiplier finite>=0.

indicators.warmup: First output max(length,atr_length)-1 (default19).
indicators.edge_cases: TR uses H-L on dataset first bar. Both basis/range must be ready.
unsettled_or_app_choices: App selects modern EMA+Wilder ATR variant, length20/ATR10/factor2. ATR10 and seeds are choices.
Pine ta.kc can use EMA of a range series; do not treat it as a numerical oracle for this variant.
verification_cases: Gap-up bar increases ATR even when high-low unchanged; basis and ATR seeds have independent lengths.

indicators.name: Donchian Channels

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; sources use the common source enum.

indicators.formula: upper=HH_n; lower=LL_n; middle=(upper+lower)/2, using current completed bar in the window.
indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default19).
indicators.edge_cases: Current-inclusive channel cannot be used as a prior channel for breakout without explicitly lagging it.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 20 documented; current inclusion is explicit app contract, no hidden one-bar shift.
verification_cases: Current new high expands same-bar channel; prior channel comparison uses lagged value.

indicators.name: Ichimoku cloud

parameters.validation: lengths integer>=1; displacement integer>=0.

indicators.formula: mid_n=(HH_n+LL_n)/2; conversion=mid_conversion; base=mid_base; leading_a=(conversion+base)/2; leading_b=mid_span_b; lagging_close=C. Compute all at t; only the renderer moves positions.
indicators.warmup: Source output indices: conversion8, base25, leading_a25, leading_b51, lagging_close0 at defaults. Display shifts do not shorten availability.
indicators.edge_cases: Store computed_at/available_at separately from plot_at; a close calculated at t remains unavailable at t-26. Extend display slots without inventing future OHLC.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 9/26/52 supported by ratings; exactly +/-26 bars chosen from support prose. A displacement-minus-one convention was not verified and must not be silently substituted.
Backtests consume source-time values. Comparing price with the cloud currently drawn at t requires the already-known spans calculated t-displacement.
verification_cases: Append future bars: source-time outputs already available never change; lagging-close plot at old slot remains unavailable before computed_at.
Default leadingB first computes at51 and plots77.

indicators.name: Supertrend

parameters.validation: atr_length integer>=1; factor finite>0.

formula: basicU=HL2+factor*ATR; basicL=HL2-factor*ATR. At first ATR-ready bar set U=basicU,L=basicL,direction=-1,line=U.
Later U=basicU if basicU<prevU or prevC>prevU else prevU; L=basicL if basicL>prevL or prevC<prevL else prevL.
If previous direction=-1, switch to +1 only if C>U; if previous direction=+1, switch to -1 only if C<L. Line=L when +1, otherwise U.
indicators.warmup: First output atr_length-1 (default9); prior values null.
indicators.edge_cases: Strict crossing: equality does not reverse; direction is app sign +1=up,-1=down.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 10/3 and initial ready-band seed are proposed defaults. Direction sign may differ from Pine output; map signs rather than assume.
Use close-only confirmed-bar flips; intrabar preview is provisional.
verification_cases: Equality with active band does not flip; cross each direction; verify carried bands when previous close crosses prior band.

indicators.name: Parabolic SAR

parameters.validation: 0<start<=maximum; increment>0; all finite.

formula: First bar null. At t=1 choose up if C1>C0 else down; initialize SAR=L0 if up else H0; EP=H1 if up else L1; AF=start.
For t>=2: candidate=prevSAR+prevAF*(prevEP-prevSAR). If up and L<candidate, reverse down: SAR=prevEP,EP=L,AF=start. If down and H>candidate, reverse up: SAR=prevEP,EP=H,AF=start.
Without reversal, up SAR=min(candidate,L[t-1],L[t-2]); down SAR=max(candidate,H[t-1],H[t-2]). If new directional extreme, update EP and AF=min(maximum,prevAF+increment); otherwise retain them.
indicators.warmup: First output index1 (two valid bars).
indicators.edge_cases: Equal-close initialization chooses down; equality at SAR does not reverse. Reversal uses previous EP; no same-bar second reversal.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Default AF values documented. Equality, EP initialization and exact reversal-before-clamp order are explicit proposed choices requiring fixtures; do not claim agreement for outside bars.
Other implementations clamp against current extreme on reversal and can differ.
verification_cases: Two-bar initialization and equal-close tie; increasing extrema AF cap; reversal/large outside bar; prior-two-bar clamp.

indicators.name: Standard pivot points (Traditional)

parameters.validation: method=traditional in this contract; period in{session,week,month}; levels=3; session calendar required.

formula: Using previous COMPLETED pivot period H,L,C: P=(H+L+C)/3; R1=2P-L; S1=2P-H; R2=P+(H-L); S2=P-(H-L); R3=2P+H-2L; S3=2P-2H+L.
Hold levels constant throughout the following period; no use of current period H/L/C.
indicators.warmup: First full prior period must exist; null in first dataset period if its predecessor is unavailable/incomplete.
indicators.edge_cases: Calendar/session boundary uses instrument timezone and configured regular/extended session; never group blindly by UTC date. Incomplete prior period returns null; daily settlement is not substituted for a bar close.
unsettled_or_app_choices: App chooses Traditional, daily session, three support/resistance levels. TradingView Standard also supports Classic/Fibonacci/Woodie/DM/Camarilla and additional levels; these are distinct formulas, not aliases.
No Auto timeframe mapping. Provider daily bars vs intraday aggregates and settlement closes must be declared.
verification_cases: Prior H=110,L=90,C=100 -> P=100,R1=110,S1=90,R2=120,S2=80,R3=130,S3=70; current-session new high cannot alter levels.
DST/overnight/holiday sessions; reject incomplete prior session.

indicators.name: Relative strength index

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; source uses common source enum.

verification_cases: Strictly rising n changes ->100; falling ->0; unchanged ->null; initial seed excludes absent first delta.

indicators.edge_cases: HH=LL gives null raw; downstream strict SMA windows restart readiness after null.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 14/3/3 and SMA documented; flat-range null and strict windows are app choices.

indicators.name: Stochastic RSI

parameters.validation: length integer>=1; constant finite>0; source uses common source enum.

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; source uses common source enum.

indicators.name: Momentum

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; source uses common source enum.

indicators.edge_cases: Zero/negative source is valid; flat source gives0.

parameters.validation: Lengths are integers >=1; source uses common source enum.

indicators.name: Ultimate oscillator

parameters.validation: Integers1<=short<medium<long; weights fixed[4,2,1].

indicators.edge_cases: Any component TR sum0 gives null entire UO; no synthetic previous close on first bar.

indicators.name: Awesome oscillator

parameters.validation: 1<=fast<slow integer; source=hl2.

indicators.edge_cases: Constant HL2 gives0. Color rising/falling against previous AO, not sign; equality uses neutral app color.

indicators.name: Average true range

parameters.validation: Length is integer>=1.

indicators.formula: TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)); if no prior close at dataset start use H-L; ATR=RMA_n(TR).
indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default13), seeded with mean of first n TR values.
indicators.edge_cases: No movement gives0. A gap from valid previous close enters TR; missing OHLC is not treated as a normal trading gap.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 14/RMA supported; exact first seed indexing follows app common convention.
verification_cases: First TR=H-L; gap includes abs distance to previous close; n3 SMA seed then alpha1/3.

indicators.name: ADX / Directional movement

parameters.validation: Length is integer>=1.

formula: Up=H-prevH; Down=prevL-L; plusDM=Up if Up>Down and Up>0 else0; minusDM=Down if Down>Up and Down>0 else0.
Starting with transitions t>=1, smooth plusDM,minusDM,TR independently by RMA_di_length. plusDI=100*smoothPlus/smoothTR; minusDI=100*smoothMinus/smoothTR.
indicators.warmup: DI first index di_length (default14); ADX first index di_length+adx_length-1 (default27). Exclude t0 TR from these aligned transition seeds.
indicators.edge_cases: If smoothTR=0 choose both DI=0; if DI sum=0 choose DX=0. Tied directional moves give both DM0.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 14/14 supported. ADX help supports Wilder recurrence; DMI help uses ambiguous EMA prose. App selects Wilder throughout, not ordinary EMA.
Seed alignment and no-movement0 exceptions are explicit app choices.
verification_cases: UpMove=DownMove>0 -> bothDM0; all-flat ->DI0,DX0,ADX0 after seeds; ADX first27.

indicators.name: Aroon

parameters.validation: Length is integer>=1.

indicators.formula: Across n+1 bars including current, find ages of maximum H and minimum L (0=current,n=oldest); up=100*(n-ageHigh)/n; down=100*(n-ageLow)/n.
indicators.warmup: First output n (default14).
indicators.edge_cases: Equal extreme values choose most recent occurrence; completely flat window gives up=down=100.
unsettled_or_app_choices: n+1 window explicitly documented in Aroon Oscillator. Length14 follows Aroon worked example, not verified UI default; most-recent tie rule proposed.
verification_cases: Oldest extreme age=n ->0; current extreme ->100; tied highs choose newest; n14 reads15bars.

indicators.name: Rolling standard deviation

parameters.validation: length integer>=1 and length>ddof; ddof in{0,1}.

indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default19).
indicators.edge_cases: Constant source gives0. Population n1 gives0; sample ddof1 requires n>=2. Use stable centered accumulation.
unsettled_or_app_choices: App default20/close/ddof0. LEAN primary source documents population convention; this does not establish TV default.
verification_cases: n3[1,2,3] ->sqrt(2/3) withddof0 and1 withddof1; constant ->0.

indicators.name: Historical volatility

parameters.validation: length integer>=2 and length>ddof; ddof in{0,1}; finite bars_per_year>0; positive closes; interval convention required.

indicators.warmup: First output n (default20); n valid log returns require n+1 positive closes.
indicators.edge_cases: Nonpositive price gives null. Flat positive prices give0. bars_per_year252 is valid only for an explicitly selected one-session daily equity convention.
unsettled_or_app_choices: TradingView help is conceptual and does not settle formula/defaults. Log returns,20,ddof0 and252 are proposed, not recovered TV parameters.
For daily 24/7 markets choose365 explicitly; intraday/week/month require explicit frequency/calendar-derived annualization rather than silently reusing252.
verification_cases: Fixed multiplicative return each bar ->0 volatility; scale bars_per_year252 vs365 changes bysqrt(365/252); reject nonpositiveclose.

indicators.name: Choppiness index

parameters.validation: length integer>=2.

indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default13), using initial H-L TR.
indicators.edge_cases: Zero high-low span or nonpositive log argument gives null; do not clamp extreme values to[0,100] because boundary gaps can affect the ratio.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 14 and formula documented; initial TR, null handling and no clamp explicitly chosen.
verification_cases: Flat range ->null; n1 rejected; boundary gap may produce out-of-range value, which is preserved.

indicators.name: Volume

parameters.validation: Required price inputs finite and valid OHLC; volume finite>=0 with meaningful-volume metadata.

indicators.formula: Output the provider's per-bar V without rescaling its physical unit.
indicators.warmup: First valid volume bar (index0 if present).
indicators.edge_cases: Zero is valid observed volume; null is missing. Negative/nonfinite volume rejected. Preserve metadata: shares/contracts/base/ticks and volume quality.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Provider metadata determines meaningfulness; app must disable dependent studies if unavailable or unsuitable. Equal close/open uses neutral app color.
verification_cases: V0 stays0; missing V staysnull; provider unit retained.

indicators.name: Volume moving average

parameters.validation: Length is integer>=1.

indicators.formula: SMA_n(V), using per-bar volume in one consistent provider unit.
indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default19).
indicators.edge_cases: Zeros count as real observations; nulls break full-window readiness. Do not average incompatible volume units.
unsettled_or_app_choices: SMA(volume) supported by official example; length20 is an app default, not claimed TradingView default.
verification_cases: n3 V[0,3,6] ->3; null not replaced with0.

indicators.name: On-balance volume

parameters.validation: Required price inputs finite and valid OHLC; volume finite>=0 with meaningful-volume metadata.

indicators.warmup: First output index0 when close/volume valid; no directional contribution from initial bar.
indicators.edge_cases: Equal closes or zero V add0. Missing required price/volume poisons cumulative total until explicitly reset/reloaded; do not silently resume as though missing flow were0.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Recurrence documented; baseline0 and cumulative gap policy are app choices. Loading more history may change absolute level.
verification_cases: C[10,11,11,9],V[5,7,8,4] ->[0,7,7,3]; missing flow invalidates tail.

indicators.name: Money flow index

parameters.validation: length integer>=1; HLC3>=0; valid nonnegative volume.

indicators.formula: TP=HLC3; flow=TP*V; positive=flow when TP>prevTP else0; negative=flow when TP<prevTP else0; P=sum_n(positive),N=sum_n(negative); MFI=100*P/(P+N).
indicators.warmup: First output index n (default14), from n transitions; prior TP is required.
indicators.edge_cases: Unchanged TP contributes neither side. If P=N=0 return null; P>0,N0 gives100; P0,N>0 gives0. Zero volume contributes0. Negative TP unsupported for this bounded money-flow variant.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 14/TP formula documented; first transition, no-flow null and nonnegative TP restriction are explicit choices.
verification_cases: Rising TP with positiveV ->100; falling ->0; unchanged TP or all-zero V ->null.

indicators.name: Chaikin money flow

parameters.validation: Length is integer>=1.

indicators.warmup: First output n-1 (default19), provided volume sum>0.
indicators.edge_cases: H=L chooses CLV0, hence contribution0; total volume0 gives null. Do not replace missing V with0.
unsettled_or_app_choices: App chooses20; source discusses20/21 and illustrates21. Zero-range0 and zero-volume null are proposed conventions.
verification_cases: H=L with positiveV contributes0; allzeroV ->null; balanced close-location flow ->0.

indicators.name: Accumulation/distribution

parameters.validation: Required price inputs finite and valid OHLC; volume finite>=0 with meaningful-volume metadata.

indicators.formula: CLV=(2*C-H-L)/(H-L); ADL[t]=sum_{i=0..t}(CLV[i]*V[i]) with cumulative baseline0 before first bar.
indicators.warmup: First output index0 equals first valid money-flow-volume contribution.
indicators.edge_cases: H=L chooses CLV0; zero V contributes0. Missing required input invalidates subsequent cumulative output until explicit reset/reload.
unsettled_or_app_choices: Initial baseline, first-bar contribution and zero-range0 are app choices. Loading earlier history shifts absolute level.
verification_cases: H10,L0,C10,V5 ->first ADL5; next close atlow,V3 ->ADL2; H=L contribution0.

indicators.name: Chaikin oscillator

parameters.validation: Integers1<=fast<slow.

indicators.formula: Chaikin=EMA_fast(ADL)-EMA_slow(ADL), using the same ADL convention as accumulation_distribution.
indicators.warmup: First output slow-1 (default9) if ADL valid fromindex0.
indicators.edge_cases: Inherits cumulative missing-volume invalidation; a constant additive ADL baseline cancels after both consistently seeded EMAs become ready.
unsettled_or_app_choices: 3/10 is source worked configuration; SMA seeds chosen by app.
verification_cases: Constant ADL ->0 afterslow seed; adding constant baseline leaves ready oscillator unchanged.

indicators.name: Session VWAP

parameters.validation: Source enum; validated instrument calendar/timezone; intraday bars must fit wholly inside configured sessions.

indicators.formula: For each configured session accumulate PV=sum(HLC3*V),Q=sum(V); VWAP=PV/Q; reset PV,Q at next session boundary before adding its first eligible bar.
indicators.warmup: First positive cumulative-volume bar of a complete session. If loaded data begins mid-session, output null until missing prefix is loaded or next known session begins.
indicators.edge_cases: Q0 gives null; subsequent zero V leaves previous VWAP unchanged. Missing volume/price invalidates rest of session; next valid complete session can recover.
unsettled_or_app_choices: HLC3 documented; exact session calendar, regular/extended inclusion and partial-session policy are app choices. Exchange timezone controls reset, chart display timezone does not.
For24/7 instruments use explicit UTC-midnight sessions. Daily bars with session resets reduce to one-bar source values, so hide/disable by default.
verification_cases: HLC3[10,20],V[1,3] ->[10,17.5]; next session resets; first zero-volume bar null.
Mid-session truncated load remainsnull; extended-session toggle/calendar/DST use explicit IDs.

indicators.name: Anchored VWAP

parameters.validation: anchor_time required timezone-aware timestamp; no implicit first-dataset-bar anchor; source enum.

indicators.formula: Beginning at explicit anchor bar a, VWAP[t]=sum_{i=a..t}(x[i]*V[i])/sum_{i=a..t}(V[i]); output null for t<a.
indicators.warmup: Anchor is required; first positive cumulative-volume bar at/after anchor and only when the anchor prefix is available.
indicators.edge_cases: Zero cumulative V gives null; later zero bars retain value. No daily reset. Missing required input invalidates later values until prefix repaired or user changes anchor.
unsettled_or_app_choices: User-selected start documented; default HLC3 and timestamp snap rule are app choices. Selecting an actual bar stores its opening timestamp; arbitrary timestamp snaps forward, never includes pre-anchor volume.
A hindsight-selected anchor may be used for drawing but cannot enter a historical strategy before its decision/creation time.
verification_cases: Anchor at second bar excludes firstbar volume; zeroV untilpositive returnsnull; crosses session withoutreset.
Late decision timestamp forbids hindsight anchor use in strategy prefix.
